product_overview: A personal portfolio website showcasing professional skills, projects, experience, and services, with integrated financial tools and a blog section to demonstrate expertise and engage users.
core_goals: Present a clear and attractive professional profile.
Provide interactive financial calculators and investment comparison tools.
Enable easy navigation across portfolio and blog content.
Support multilingual blog content with MDX processing.
Ensure smooth user experience with animations and search functionality.
key_features: Global navigation bar and footer for site-wide consistent navigation.
Portfolio sections including Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Experience, Services, Contact, Objective, Showcase, and CV sections.
Interactive financial calculators: FinancialCalculator, InvestmentComparison, PortfolioBuilder.
Search functionality to find content across the site.
Blog system with fetching and MDX processing for content management.
Animation wrappers to enhance UI transitions and engagement.
user_flow_summary: Users land on the homepage featuring the Hero section and global navigation.
Users navigate through portfolio sections to learn about skills, projects, experience, and services.
Users interact with financial tools to calculate investments and build portfolios.
Users search for specific content using the search overlay feature.
Users browse the blog section with multilingual support to read posts.
Users can contact through the Contact section to request services or further info.
validation_criteria: All navigation links and footer links function correctly across pages.
Portfolio sections load and display accurate content without errors.
Financial tools perform calculations accurately and update results interactively.
Search returns relevant results quickly and highlights matches.
Blog posts load correctly with proper MDX rendering and multilingual support.
Animations trigger smoothly without causing UI glitches or performance issues.
